name: Turnout in mayoral general elections
definition: Votes cast for mayor in the November general election as a share of the city's citizen voting-age population (U.S. citizens 18 and older) that year.

source.name: NYC Board of Elections certified Statement and Return reports, Mayor (citywide recap), general elections 2005-2025; Census Bureau ACS 1-year estimates

method: Turnout = votes recorded for mayor / citizen voting-age population x 100. Votes recorded for mayor are the Board of Elections' certified 'Total Votes' for the office (all candidates and write-ins; ballots left blank or overvoted for mayor, shown as 'Unrecorded', are excluded). The denominator is ACS 1-year table B29001 (citizen voting-age population) for New York city for the same year; B29001 is not published for 2005-2013, so for those years it is built from table B05003 as people 18+ minus non-citizens 18+ (male B05003_008-B05003_012 plus female B05003_019-B05003_023), which reproduces B29001 exactly in 2017 (checked). Borough breakdown uses the county recap totals over county B29001. Figures: 2005: 1,289,935 votes for mayor (1,315,360 ballots) / 4,716,299 CVAP (ACS 1-year B05003); 2009: 1,154,802 votes for mayor (1,178,057 ballots) / 5,159,802 CVAP (ACS 1-year B05003); 2013: 1,087,710 votes for mayor (1,102,400 ballots) / 5,294,114 CVAP (ACS 1-year B05003); 2017: 1,148,665 votes for mayor (1,166,314 ballots) / 5,530,640 CVAP (ACS 1-year B29001, MOE +/-21,106); 2021: 1,125,258 votes for mayor (1,149,172 ballots) / 5,546,959 CVAP (ACS 1-year B29001, MOE +/-27,010); 2025: 2,194,204 votes for mayor (2,218,647 ballots) / 5,814,406 CVAP (ACS 1-year B29001, MOE +/-30,278).
caveats: The denominator is a survey estimate with a margin of error; turnout margins of error are not published and are not computed here.
Total ballots cast (including ballots with no vote for mayor) run about 1-2 percent higher than votes for mayor; the figures are in method.
The CVAP counts all adult citizens, including those not registered, so this is lower than turnout of registered voters.
